name: Last Mile L17: The Ferryman's Right (Capstone)

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
This ability is not for escape. It is for people who cannot escape themselves.

The Ferryman's Right — 1/session. You may carry one Soul that the world would not otherwise release:

  • A prisoner from a place that does not release prisoners

  • A dying ally whose time has come

  • A refugee from a destroyed or sealed hex

  • A ghost from a haunting that the haunting cannot end on its own

  • A name that Lore has tried to forget

The carry costs you. Choose at the moment of acceptance:

  • 1 permanent point of Stress maximum (your Stress max is reduced by 1 forever; this stacks across multiple uses), OR

  • 25 Radiation points added to your system.radiation.rp (one full minor threshold, permanent until cleansed).

The Soul arrives at a destination you declare, alive and whole — or as whole as the journey permits. Some Souls become more themselves on the journey. Some become less. The cost paid by the Ferryman is non-negotiable.

This ability cannot be used to remove a creature from an ongoing combat round. It cannot be used to escape your own death. It cannot be repeated for the same Soul on the same session.

system.requirements: Route of the Last Mile, Shadow Courier Initiation 17
